items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 44:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the six corrections of the beard of ZA? When ZA is in the aspect of VAK, lacking a head, he does not receive illumination except in the aspect of the six corrections of the beard from the beard of AA, called: Erech Apayim, VeRav Chesed, VeNosei Avon, VaPesha, VeNakeh. Explanation: for the Nefesh-Ruach-Neshama-Chaya-Yechida of the Nefesh of the beard, he receives from the first three corrections of the beard of AA, which are the aspect of the Yod-He-Vav of the first HaVaYaH of the beard. And the Nefesh-Ruach of the Ruach he receives from the Vav-He of the middle HaVaYaH of the beard of AA, and from the Yod of the lower HaVaYaH, which are: VeEmet, VeNotzer Chesed LaAlafim. And the three first ones illuminate to the three measures of ZA, which are: Erech, Apayim, and Rav Chesed. And the three second ones of AA illuminate only to the two measures of ZA, which are: Nosei Avon and Pesha. And the He of the upper HaVaYaH, which is the fourth correction of AA, Erech, with the He of the middle HaVaYaH, which is the eighth correction of AA, illuminate to the sixth correction of ZA, VeNakeh. (Items 221, and 223, 224, 225).
